candidates.change_summary: Replace the balance update with assigning only msg.value minus nothing, i.e. set instead of add: balances[msg.sender] = msg.value.
Delete the balance update statement so deposits never credit the caller.
Add msg.value / 2 instead of the full msg.value to the caller's balance.
Delete the statement that decrements the caller's balance after withdrawal.
Move the balance decrement before the transfer, so the balance is zeroed before the ether is sent (reentrancy-order change).
Replace the transfer amount with the contract's entire balance.
Change the require guard from `<=` to `<`, forbidding withdrawal of the exact full balance.
